text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 白色圆领修身背心，奶油色直筒宽松牛仔长裤，黑色细带凉鞋。配饰：黑色细腰带；草编肩包；黑色窄框墨镜。按自然穿搭位置或旁置排列，无人无人台。
original_prompt: Edit this catalog image. Preserve all garments exactly, their colors and construction, on pure white. REMOVE ALL feet, toes, ankles, human skin, mannequin parts inside or below trousers. Show the pair of EMPTY black sandals separately BESIDE the trousers, viewed from above with smooth flat insoles, clearly unworn shoes. Trousers end above blank white background, nothing emerging from hems. No body parts anywhere. Correct the white tank to a broad U-shaped SCOOP neckline, not a crew or high neck. Keep cream fixed-waist five-pocket jeans, black belt, dark brown woven bag and black sunglasses.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
